publisher: Auburn University Board of Trustees / Facilities Management
relevant_reported_facts: Existing terminal ramp expansion proposed to the north.
Base project adds 8,760 square yards of ramp and 15 aircraft tie-down spaces.
Bid alternates 1 and 2 add 2,660 square yards and 8 tie-downs; alternate 3 adds five helicopter pads.
